title: Dragons+++
description: Adds a whole bunch of dragons, magic and other things.
body:
This is a fantsay/steampunk modpack focusing mainly on adding dragons and magic, but also adds a bit of tech and some new farming mechanics. Also features new terrain generation for overworld, nether and end, as well as overhauling a few structures. Can't remember if there are new dimensions so ig you'll have to find out lol.

**Features mods such as;**

- DragN's Livestock Overhaul
- Book of Dragons
- Saint's Dragons
- Ice and Fire
- When Dungeons Arise
- Mowzie's Mobs
- Xaero's World/Minimap
- Waystones
- Create
- Farmers Delight
- Traveller's Backpack
- Ars Noveau
- The Dawn Era
- Amplified Nether
- Unusual End
- Biomes O' Plenty
- ShellBound for AirShip

to name a small handful. Also has Simple Voice Chat, Essentials and Lootr for multiplayer :DD
